method: Direct pikepdf annotation dictionaries and rendered primary pages were used. Each cited strike has been checked against its linked Caret (IRT/NM); the affected sentence/table row and printed footer were read in context. Current audit statements were then compared to named assertion bodies and caller scope.
coverage: Six issue IDs, eight linked strike/caret replacements, plus the separately unpaired deletion in #251 and #276 note-label insertion. No whole-clause certification.

features.effective_change: Two exact text replacements define object numbers as positive non-zero decimal digit strings without leading + or leading zeros; generation numbers are nonnegative and may be the single digit 0. Both pairs visibly target the two indirect-object identifier bullets.

overlay_pairs.caret: A PDF object number is a positive (non-zero) decimal integer comprised only of digits. It shall not have a leading PLUS SIGN ("+", 2Bh) and shall not start with leading zeros ("0").
A PDF generation number is a non-negative decimal integer: its syntax requirements are identical to those of a PDF object number (above), except that the single digit "0" shall also be permitted.

features.current_test_evidence: file_structure_current maps the change to object identity and generation lookup. `crates/pdf-syntax/tests/spec_basic_objects.rs::a_cold_wrong_generation_reference_is_undefined` distinguishes the defined-generation control from a wrong-generation reference. It does not test textual serialization of leading plus/zero forms; no such reader rejection is required by these producer syntax statements.
features.assessment: Source target and bounded test claim align. Do not claim the lookup test proves the full lexical writer grammar.

features.effective_change: The caret replaces the narrower conditional statement with a rule that all Table 5 common-stream entry values and nested array elements/dictionary values in a cross-reference stream are direct objects, and prohibits Table 5 /F.
features.current_test_evidence: xref_dictionary_cells_current correctly limits directness to Table 17 plus Table 5 common stream entries and keeps trailer Root's separate indirect reference rule. `spec_objxref_audit::generated_cross_reference_stream_has_direct_table17_values_and_no_trailer_keyword` checks a valid generated stream's direct table entries. It is not exhaustive over every Table 5 nested value; invalid indirect producer forms do not imply an ISO-required reader rejection.
features.assessment: Correct target and scope; evidence is representative rather than a complete per-key matrix, as the current shard states.

features.effective_change: The replacement states the general byte-string rule (literal or hexadecimal unless context says otherwise), supplies the file-ID example and a signature Contents hexadecimal-string note. The strike removes the old ID-only example paragraph. A separate unlinked caret inserts the numeral 2 after the subsection's existing NOTE label, numbering that surviving note NOTE 2 after the inserted NOTE 1; it is editorial cross-reference structure, not another representation rule.
features.current_test_evidence: errata_numeric_syntax_batch_current maps the generic rule correctly. `literal_strings_names_audit.rs` compares literal and hex spellings to the same bytes; signature serialization tests separately check hexadecimal Contents. These exercise the general alternative and a stated-context exception.
features.assessment: Correct. Preserve 'unless otherwise stated': the generic syntax test does not override field-specific signature representation rules.

separate_unlinked_caret.target: The caret is positioned immediately after the surviving NOTE label at the bottom of the subsection and renumbers it NOTE 2.

features.effective_change: The missing-timezone sentence is replaced with the explicit GMT (+0'00) assumption. A second strike, with no linked replacement, deletes the next sentence claiming the rest of the date is local time regardless of a stated timezone.

overlay_pairs_and_deletion.caret: the missing timezone offset shall be assumed to be the same as Greenwich Mean Time's timezone offset (+0'00)

overlay_pairs_and_deletion.note: This independent strike removes the rest-of-date local-time sentence; it is not part of the replacement's own QuadPoints.

features.current_test_evidence: tree_string_cells_current accurately records both target effects. Date tests retain parsed offset presence but compute instants using a zero absent offset; `dates_order_by_the_instant_rather_than_by_the_string` exercises the observable arithmetic. No parser calendar-validity result is claimed.
features.assessment: Current source-to-test interpretation is consistent. The old local-time sentence was not left operative.

features.effective_change: The replacement narrows a valid embedded-file Subtype to the RFC 2046 section-2 MIME media type name without parameters/subparameters (top-level type and subtype). This is producer syntax, not an instruction to reject a file at read time.
features.current_test_evidence: file_specification_cells_current and embedded_file_cells_current classify the constraint as producer-facing. Current extraction preserves subtype metadata and examples use valid values; those are not assertions that the reader rejects bad producer spellings.
features.assessment: No source/test attribution error or normative reader gap found in the bounded check.

features.effective_change: Two linked changes with the same issue number occur in different clauses. On p153, the old embedded-stream inclusion bullets are replaced: a FileSpec must provide EF when embedding, EF/RF are the embedding routes, file-attachment annotations require an embedded stream, and the document-level EmbeddedFiles name-tree route is optional unless another rule requires it. On p656, the slideshow NOTE changes other media storage to FileSpec dictionaries, typically with an embedded stream.

overlay_pairs.caret_text_prefix: Replace the text and bullets below the NOTE as follows: Embedded file streams shall only be included in a PDF file using file specification dictionaries that have an EF entry...

overlay_pairs.caret: as file specification dictionaries (see 7.11.3, "File specification dictionaries"), typically with an embedded file stream.

features.current_test_evidence: file_specification_cells_current is scoped to the p153 Table 44/45 cells and accurately records the p153 edit. remaining_multimedia_controls_current separately records the p656 note and correctly explains that §13.5 explicitly says processor support for alternate presentations is not required; no slideshow test is claimed. Ordinary EF/FileSpec attachment tests are not slideshow execution tests.
features.assessment: The separate-clause correction is accounted for across the owner shards; neither summary claims the p153 review is a complete review of every #481 occurrence. No supported reader obligation is omitted.

limits: No tests run in this review.
This is a source/claim check of selected annotations, not a reader or producer certification.
No mandatory reader rejection is inferred from these producer-side syntactic rules.
